run.system_prompt: Answer the question using the user's stored conversation memory. The current date is 2026/01/02 (Fri) 12:00. Use the available native memory tools as needed to search, scope, and fetch the relevant stored conversations before answering. Give a concise, direct answer. If the stored conversations do not contain enough information, explicitly say that the question cannot be answered from memory. Do not use external knowledge.
run.user_input: What passphrase did I ask you to remember?

tools.name: search_memories
tools.description: Search past conversations and return compact memory summaries. Use fetch_memories for selected IDs that need full text. For named entities/topics, prefer search_subjects -> search_memories_in_subjects.

tools.name: search_subjects
tools.description: Search the user's subject graph and return subject objects with id, name, description, and similarity.

tools.name: fetch_memories
tools.description: Fetch full conversation text for selected memory pair IDs.

tools.name: search_memories_in_subjects
tools.description: Semantic memory search inside one subject. Use focused queries; fetch selected IDs for full text.

subject_id.description: Subject ID from search_subjects or the prompt
